enabled.description: Whether the fwupd daemon should start automatically.

staging_dir.description: Directory where firmware images are staged before installation.

cache_dir.description: Directory for cached firmware metadata and checksums.

log_dir.description: Directory for daemon and plugin logs.

firmware_dir.description: Optional local directory to serve firmware files from (leave blank to use remote repos like LVFS).

remote.description: URL of the remote metadata feed for this channel

firmware_channels.description: Configure firmware update channels. Each channel maps to a remote metadata feed.

show_version_in_gui.description: Whether firmware versions should appear in GUI update notifications.

firmware_verification.description: Require verified firmware signatures. Enabling is strongly recommended for security.

min_power.description: Minimum battery percentage (0–100) required to proceed with firmware updates. Set to 0 to disable.

min_time.description: Minimum time remaining on battery (seconds) before updates are allowed. Set to 0 to disable.

max_attempts.description: Maximum number of retry attempts for a failed firmware update.

retry_delay.description: Seconds to wait before retrying a failed update.

automatic_background_updates.description: Enable automatic background update checks and installations (when system is idle).

suppress_power_screen.description: Suppress power-saving features (e.g., screen blanking) during long-running firmware updates.

ignored_device_flags.description: List of device flags to ignore (useful for known-bad firmware scenarios).

items.description: Hardware GId (e.g., 'usb:046d:c52b') of devices to exclude from updates.

ignored_device_gids.description: List of hardware device IDs to completely skip during updates.

debug_logging.description: Enable verbose debug logging (for troubleshooting only).

local_metadata_signing.description: Use local signing keys for firmware metadata (advanced; not needed for LVFS).

local_metadata_key.description: Path to private signing key (required if local_metadata_signing=true).

lvfs_testing.description: Enable testing firmware from LVFS (Linux Vendor Firmware Service). Usually disabled in production.

max_firmware_size.description: Maximum firmware file size (bytes) allowed for download. 0 = no limit. Recommend ≤1073741824 (1 GiB).

device_reenumerate.description: Re-enumerate device (trigger USB/HID reprobe) after firmware update if needed.

offline_updates.description: Enable offline update mode (for OEM imaging, pre-installation in initramfs).

offline_update_lock_file.description: Lock file path used to prevent concurrent offline update attempts.
